[P2] Keep the configuration unit test independent of AWS

This call builds a default `DurableConfig`, whose `createDefaultDurableExecutionClient()` immediately calls `getDurableExecutionState()` to warm up the Lambda client. With AWS environment credentials present, the test therefore sends a real request and can wait on network retries or timeouts, despite the helper's no-network claim. This violates AGENTS.md's unit-test requirements to mock dependencies and avoid external dependencies. Under rule 9, return to the design phase in rule 8, step 6, and separate pure configuration testing from production client construction.
